scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules dist apps/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter client lint && pnpm --filter server lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter @mock-api-builder/schema typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mock-api-builder/schema test && pnpm --filter client test:coverage && pnpm --filter server test:cov
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.verify: pnpm build:packages && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:apps
